feature_restrictions: STC_HAS_TYPEOF=0 is exported by the CMake targets to select the upstream C99 fallback for sum-type helpers.
Use i_no_atomic or i_opt=c_no_atomic for C99 non-atomic arc reference counting. Atomic mode depends on compiler intrinsics or C11 atomics and is outside this bundle C99 validation.
Strict C99 compilation validates selected public APIs on tested toolchains, not all macro combinations or all target platforms.
Coroutines retained: timer helpers use portable POSIX APIs (sys/time.h/select) or the upstream Win32 alternative; user explicitly allows POSIX. This is not a freestanding library.

notes: CMake integration verified in a standalone temporary project using the same lmx_c99_target contract.
All 93 retained upstream files verified byte-identical to release archive.

ISO_C99_math: System C math library (m on UNIX/MinGW; typically supplied by the standard runtime on MSVC).
platform_api: POSIX timer/select APIs on POSIX systems, normally provided by libc; upstream Win32 alternative for Windows.
